meta.name: linkedin-profile-optimizer
meta.description: Audit and rewrite a LinkedIn profile end-to-end for 2026: headline, About 7-step, Featured, banner, photo, Experience metrics, Skills, custom URL, recommendations. Triggers on "review my profile", "rewrite my headline", "fix my About", "optimize banner", "profile audit", "LinkedIn bio". Converts resume-style profiles to ones that convert 3-5x better. Not for writing feed content (use linkedin-post-writer).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把简历式的领英主页改写成能吸引机会的版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让领英主页带来更多面试或客户
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite your LinkedIn profile so it attracts recruiters and clients
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your LinkedIn profile to win more interviews or clients

howto.what: Claude 会按 2026 标准审查你 LinkedIn 资料的九个板块(照片、标题、About、Featured、Experience 等),给出评分卡、按影响排序的修改项,以及每个不达标板块的改写前后对照。
howto.when: 当你贴上 LinkedIn 资料链接要求审查、想改写标题或 About 板块,或提到 “profile audit” 等关键词时触发;不负责写动态内容。

say.text: 帮我审查一下我的 LinkedIn 资料,目标是吸引客户
say.note: 先按九个板块逐项打分

say.text: 按求职方向重写我的标题和 About
say.note: 标题用满 220 字符,About 按七步结构

say.text: 把 Experience 每一条改成动词加具体数据
say.note: 每个职位补 5 个以上技能

howto.what_en: Claude audits the nine sections of your LinkedIn profile against 2026 criteria and returns a scorecard, ranked fixes, and before→after rewrites of each failing section.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste your LinkedIn URL for an audit, ask to rewrite your headline or About, or mention "profile audit" and similar keywords.

say_en.text: Review my LinkedIn profile — my goal is attracting clients
Rewrite my headline and About for job seeking
Turn my Experience bullets into action verb + metric lines
